title: Device Desktop Workspace local-only file and terminal control with governed environment impact

phases.objective: Validate the Windows Device Workspace client wiring to the loopback connector and its scoped file and terminal HTTP contracts; preserve independent live Staging certification and deny implicit Production mutations.

e2e_journeys.actor: Windows Local Manager operator using explicitly entered local credentials
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Local-only desktop controls route through the authenticated connector and enforce device, file-write and terminal boundaries, without persisting approval tokens or granting Production authority.
steps: Open the Device Workspace form and ensure loopback-only connector routing and in-memory secret handling.
Verify scoped file and terminal HTTP requests reject missing authentication or approval and obey device-bound path constraints.
assertions: Windows form wiring uses loopback and does not silently fallback to a public endpoint.
Local Connector HTTP boundary rejects unapproved or invalid operations.
Live Staging certification remains a separate release prerequisite; no Production deployment is authorized.
